summary: Behaviour-preserving refactor of node selection (router 0.37.1, ADR-0108 proposed). scheduler.assess replaces the mirrored candidates_for/_node_block judgement; candidates_for and choose no longer change state; the expired-open -> half_open breaker transition moved to scheduler.probe_breakers, called by the two request paths (proxy._Acquire before every choose, ops.run_shadow before its candidates_for); views never mutated and still do not. Budget arithmetic shares nodes.card_gib/Node.card_budget_gib, the measured-occupancy sum shares Node._real_gib (same float summation order), loading_for/tier_loading share one loop. Traced: B6/TM-05 - the cloud data-class and provider gate (Routing.tier_blocked, cloud.provider_block_reason) is unchanged and still applied in choose before any tier is judged; probe_breakers calls the same pure tier_blocked and only moves a breaker, it selects nothing and sends nothing; a cloud tier still yields a candidate only through candidates_for with the same breaker test. TM-08 (stage 3 breaker, admission): the probe reaches exactly the targets the old mutating selection reached (tiers not blocked by the request, not excluded, nodes offering the model and passing offline/draining/busy), so a failing node is probed once and re-opens on one failure as before; admission and deadlines untouched. B3: agent-reported facts (mem_pressure, upstream_blocked, standby_models, VRAM) are read as before and remain assertions of that host; no new trust in them. B1: the availability endpoint keeps its auth check and response fields; 503 blocker fields are unchanged except one corner the agent does not report (held server's model loaded while the standby serves, under memory pressure or the agent's RAM block), which now reports memory_pressure with the same RAM fields used elsewhere instead of no reason - no new data exposed. B9/TM-15: journal entries (breaker half_open, no_node blockers) keep their shape and content; no new logging. TM-16: ci.yml only gains one self-test line; no action, permission or review-policy change. No configuration, dependency, endpoint, agent or deployment change. Added text names no organisation, host, address or person.

tests.evidence: 2112-state matrix: candidates_for, assess, blockers and choose agree; selection changes no breaker and writes no journal; probe_breakers moves exactly the due breakers past the state gate, nodes and a cloud provider (request-blocked and excluded tiers untouched). Instrument checked: four drifted schedulers (extra filter in candidates_for, pre-0.37.1 explanation order, impure selection, probe ignoring the gate) each make it fail.

Injected divergences were detected.

Public-change scan: 0 finding(s); added lines reviewed manually.

limitations: A future request path that selects without calling probe_breakers would let an expired breaker through with the same verdict but without marking it half_open (no probe penalty, re-open after the normal failure count instead of one failure); both existing request paths call it, the self-test guards purity, not the callers.

The differential comparison ran on random synthetic states with stub catalog figures; it does not cover concurrency across awaits (the selection has none) or the proxy's wait/retry loop beyond the end-to-end suite.
check_adr_index stays red on this branch until the PRs holding ADR-0101..0107 are merged; this is ordering, not content.
